semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: While 'robotic manipulation' often involves elements of planning and control to manipulate objects effectively, this domain composes a significant aspect of manipulation tasks, hence it is semantically equivalent.
Robot learning is a critical component of robotic manipulation, involving algorithms that help robots learn manipulation tasks, making it semantically related.

parent_domains.justification: 'Robotic manipulation' is a subfield within the broader category of 'robotics', focusing on how robots interact physically with the world to perform tasks.
This domain encompasses various components, including manipulation which is often a significant functionality in robotic systems.
As a base form, 'robotic' serves as an overarching category that includes any aspect related to robotics including manipulation.

closest_parent_domain.justification: The domain of 'robotics' provides the closest encompassing category as it covers all aspects of robot operations including manipulation, aligning closely with 'robotic manipulation'.

child_domains.justification: This area could act as a subset under robotic manipulation when considering human-guided manipulation tasks.

closest_child_domain.justification: This domain closely relates to manipulative actions in robotics where planning and navigating form integral parts of manipulation operations.
